szenen.text: What happens when two thirds of a coin unlock at once? About 65% of ALLO's circulating supply unlocks on November 11.
160 million tokens go to early backers and core contributors. That is about 17 times bigger than the last monthly unlocks.
After all 4 previous ALLO unlocks, the price fell within 7 days, by 2 to 12%. Before them: 2 pumps, 2 drops.
Since October 1, ALLO is {chg}. This unlock is much bigger than all four before.
